situations.title: 1차평가 ABCDE 순서
situations.tagline: It hurts everywhere—I don't even know what's wrong with me.
situations.brief: 기도·호흡·순환·의식·노출 순서로 1차평가를 체계적으로 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you tell me your name and what happened?
Take a deep breath for me—does it hurt to breathe?
I'm checking you head to toe now.

situations.title: 경추 보호 설명
situations.tagline: My neck is killing me—can I just sit up a little?
situations.brief: 도수 정렬과 경추 칼라의 필요성을 설명하고 환자 움직임을 통제하세요.
keyPhrases: Please don't move your neck—hold still for me.
We're keeping your head in line to protect your spine.
The collar stays on until we clear your neck.

situations.title: 활력·쇼크지수 사정
situations.tagline: My heart is racing and I feel really lightheaded.
situations.brief: 빈맥·저혈압 등 활력징후로 쇼크지수를 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm taking your pulse and blood pressure now.
Do you feel dizzy when you lift your head?
Your heart rate is high—we're watching you closely.

situations.title: 통증 부위 신속 확인
situations.tagline: It hurts here on my side, and my leg too, I think.
situations.brief: AVPU로 의식을 확인하고 통증 부위를 손상 지도화하세요.
keyPhrases: Point to exactly where it hurts the most.
Does it hurt when I press here?
Any pain in your back or belly?

situations.title: 수상기전(MOI) 청취
situations.tagline: The car hit us going pretty fast—I was in the passenger seat.
situations.brief: 속도·안전벨트·튕김 등 수상기전을 청취해 손상 위험을 예측하세요.
keyPhrases: How fast was the car going?
Were you wearing a seatbelt?
Were you thrown from the vehicle at all?

situations.title: 둔상 다발외상 트리아지
situations.tagline: There are two of us hurt—please help my friend first, he's worse.
situations.brief: 우선순위를 판단하고 역할을 배분하며 둔상 다발외상 트리아지를 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: We're assessing both of you right now.
Tell me who has trouble breathing or is bleeding heavily.
The team is dividing up to care for each of you.

situations.title: 은닉 출혈 저혈압
situations.tagline: I don't have much pain, but I feel weirdly cold and faint.
situations.brief: 외견이 경미해도 내부출혈에 의한 저혈압 가능성을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Does your belly feel tender or full anywhere?
You look pale—we're watching for internal bleeding.
We're getting scans to look inside.

situations.title: 골반 골절 순환 불안정
situations.tagline: My hips feel crushed and I'm getting so dizzy.
situations.brief: 골반 바인더를 적용하고 대량출혈에 대비하며 순환 불안정을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: We're placing a binder to stabilize your pelvis.
Please don't move your hips or legs.
We're preparing blood in case you need it.

situations.title: 항응고제 복용 외상
situations.tagline: I only fell a little, but I take blood thinners every day.
situations.brief: 항응고제 복용자에서 경미한 손상도 출혈 확대 위험이 있음을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Which blood thinner do you take?
When was your last dose?
Even a minor injury can bleed more with these.

situations.title: 관통상 다발
situations.tagline: There's something still stuck in my side—don't pull it out!
situations.brief: 궤적을 파악하고 박힌 물체 제거를 금지하며 관통상을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: We're leaving the object in place and stabilizing it.
Try to stay very still for me.
How many times were you struck?

situations.title: 고령 낙상 다발외상
situations.tagline: I just slipped in the kitchen, but everything hurts so much.
situations.brief: 저에너지 손상도 중증일 수 있음을 인지하고 복약력을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Did you hit your head when you fell?
What medications are you taking?
Even a small fall can cause serious injury at your age.

situations.title: 언어장벽 외상
situations.tagline: Pain... here. No English. Allergy... no know.
situations.brief: 언어장벽 환자에서 통증·알레르기·기왕력을 몸짓과 통역으로 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: Point to where the pain is worst.
Any allergy to medicine? Yes or no?
I'm getting an interpreter for you now.

situations.title: 임신부 외상 1차평가
situations.tagline: I'm 28 weeks pregnant—please make sure my baby is okay.
situations.brief: 좌측위를 취하고 모체와 태아를 함께 사정하며 임신부 외상 1차평가를 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: We're tilting you to your left side to help blood flow.
Any belly pain, bleeding, or contractions?
We're checking both you and your baby.

situations.title: 대량수혈 프로토콜 준비 설명
situations.tagline: You're giving him how much blood? Is he going to make it?
situations.brief: 혈액·응고인자 준비를 설명하고 가족을 지지하며 대량수혈 프로토콜을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: He's losing a lot of blood, so we're replacing it fast.
We're giving blood and clotting factors together.
The team is doing everything they can right now.

situations.title: 저체온 예방
situations.tagline: I'm freezing... I can't stop shivering.
situations.brief: 노출 후 보온으로 저체온을 예방하고 사망 삼징후를 경계하세요.
keyPhrases: We're covering you with warm blankets now.
Keeping you warm helps your blood clot properly.
Tell me if you keep feeling cold.

situations.title: 긴장성 기흉 급속악화
situations.tagline: I can't... breathe... my chest... something's wrong...
situations.brief: 호흡음 소실과 급속 악화를 인지하고 긴장성 기흉의 응급 감압을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Your breath sounds are absent on one side.
We need to release the pressure in your chest now.
Stay with me—we're helping you breathe.
goals: 호흡음 소실 등 긴장성 기흉을 인지한다

situations.title: 출혈성 쇼크 급속진행
situations.tagline: *pale, weak pulse, barely responsive*
situations.brief: 무맥 임박을 인지하고 대량수혈을 가동하며 출혈성 쇼크에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: We're giving blood as fast as we can.
Applying pressure to control the bleeding.
Stay with me—open your eyes if you can.

situations.title: 외상성 심정지 대응
situations.tagline: *no pulse, CPR in progress*
situations.brief: 기흉·탐포네이드 등 가역 원인을 동시에 교정하며 외상성 심정지에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Continue compressions—checking for tension pneumothorax.
Bilateral chest decompression now.
Assessing for cardiac tamponade with ultrasound.
goals: 외상성 심정지의 가역 원인을 동시에 교정한다

situations.title: 다발외상 핸드오프
situations.tagline: Trauma handoff—injuries, fluids given, and blood products.
situations.brief: 손상·수액·혈액 정보를 SBAR로 정리해 다발외상 환자를 핸드오프하세요.
keyPhrases: MVC at highway speed, unrestrained driver.
Pelvic and femur fractures, binder in place.
Two units of blood given, BP now stabilizing.

situations.title: 수술실 즉시 이송 조율
situations.tagline: They said he needs surgery right now—I don't understand what's happening.
situations.brief: 개복 판단을 설명하고 가족 동의를 얻으며 수술실 즉시 이송을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: He has internal bleeding that needs surgery now.
We're taking him straight to the operating room.
I need your consent to proceed immediately.

situations.title: 기도 화상·안면외상 기도위기
situations.tagline: My face got burned and my throat feels like it's swelling shut.
situations.brief: 기도 화상·안면외상에서 조기 삽관 필요성을 사정하고 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Is it getting harder to breathe or swallow?
Your airway may swell, so we're securing it early.
We're preparing to place a breathing tube now.
